configuration.reference: same archived N+W 8192 views; no evaluation reference
configuration.df: 1+sum(eig(H_W K_WW H_W)/(eig+n*alpha)); target original corresponding native lane
configuration.df_matching: FIT only, log-alpha bisection [-40,40]; unreachable retained as unavailable
configuration.negative_eigenvalues: reject below -1e-10*max(1,maxabs eigenvalue); clip only negative roundoff to zero
configuration.common_kernel: a=H G_up H/s_linear; b=H G_down H/s_linear; C components centered separately over entire FIT; original global quadratic scale
configuration.native_mask_kernel: same two-stage center/trace recipe independently fit to each fixed 8-token mask
configuration.population: already opened Dev640..895; all 256 worlds x2 variants x8 masks

conclusion_scope: Exploratory known-Dev interventions; matching df does not match anisotropic shrinkage, and one matched alpha does not rule out all scalar regularization.
